title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill 3 Berry Berry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Berry Berry by Doozy Seriously Pod Fill 3 is a vibrant celebration of red berries. This flavour delivers a juicy fusion of sweet, sun-ripened Strawberries and sharp, tangy Raspberries. It creates a perfectly balanced fruit profile that is both sweet and refreshing. The Seriously Pod Fill 3 range by Doozy Vape Co. is designed specifically for vapers who prefer the mouth-to-lung (MTL) style but want the value and convenience of a shortfill bottle. Unlike standard shortfills, these e-liquids are mixed with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, making them perfectly compatible with low-wattage pod kits and starter devices. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 10ml 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Because of the 50/50 ratio, the final mix will remain thin enough to wick perfectly in your pod coils, delivering excellent flavour and coil longevity. All Doozy Vape Co. e-liquids are made in the UK to the highest standards, featuring childproof caps and tamper-evident seals. What Coils and Nic shot to use with this liquid: Coils with 1.5ohm to 1.2ohms any 50PG/50VG nic shot can be used NOT suited for Sub-Ohm Vaping. Coils with 1.0ohm to 0.6ohm any 50PG/50VG nic shot can be used NOT suited for Sub-Ohm Vaping. Coils with 0.4ohm to 0.1ohm any High VG (70VG/30PG or 80VG/20PG) Nic shot can be used to make this a Sub-Ohm E-Liquid. This would NOT be suited for MTL vaping as the wick in the coil will struggle to absorb the E-Liquid as it will be thicker.
